test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is a possible consequence if a CNC machine stops suddenly during actual cutting movement?

options.text: Automatic tool replacement without any damage
Tool breakage and tool marks on the workpiece
No effect on the tool or the workpiece
Only a minor delay in restarting the program

solution:
The correct answer is __Tool breakage and tool marks on the workpiece.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tool breakage__ and __tool marks__ on the workpiece are common consequences when a CNC machine stops suddenly during actual cutting movement.
 
• Sudden stoppage can cause abrupt forces on the tool, leading to breakage.
 
• It can also leave unintended marks or damage on the workpiece, reducing its quality.
 
• Restarting the machine after such an incident may require realignment or reprogramming of the tool path.
 
• Preventive measures include regular maintenance and real-time monitoring of CNC machines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Preventive Maintenance:**

 
 
• Involves regular inspection and servicing of CNC machines to avoid sudden stoppages.
 
• Ensures smooth operation and reduces the risk of tool damage.
 
 
 
• **Tool Path Optimization: **
 
 
• Helps in minimizing abrupt movements during machining.
 
• Improves the overall efficiency and lifespan of the tool.
 
 
 
• **Emergency Stop System:**
 
 
• CNC machines are equipped with emergency stop buttons to prevent further damage during unforeseen stoppages.
 
• Operators must be trained to handle emergency situations effectively.
